periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal cranial axis, sloping downwards towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with the longitudinal dimension approximately 1.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering at the ventral-anterior margin of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape across the posterior margin with minimal anterior indentation at the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 30% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant gap, roughly equivalent to the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semi-circular curvature at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-beige chromatic shift across the primary white fur regions, most prominent on the neck and back.
